text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-M-07, Stainless Steel Foucault Cabinet Knob

The Stainless Steel Foucault Cabinet Door Knob is on trend. The clean, simple lines are perfect to accent your modern decor; but what really makes this knob trendy is the brushed stainless steel finish that will offset the bold colors that are so popular in today's decorating. And since it is made out of stainless steel, you know that it will last. The simplicity of this Acorn made knob is a true strength because you know that no matter what is in next season, this knob will be a fixture in your home--never going out of style.

Also Available Matching Foucault Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Foucault Cabinet Door Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
